raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The unified radix tree could free FULL KV pages that a node still mapped. A request owns FULL pages only from its protected prefix (`prev_prefix_len`) upward; below it, the request's row holds the node's own canonical page ids by reference. `SWAComponent.update_component_on_insert_overlap` recovered an SWA-tombstoned fragment from the request's row starting at the request's SWA eviction cursor, and clamped that cursor to the protected prefix only for independent windows.

A single-chunk request has a cursor of 0, and a read-only FULL prefix match can leave the protected prefix strictly inside a node, so the recovery also covered pages the request never owned. Those pages were freed as if they were the request's duplicates (the swap branch's old FULL ids, or the locked branch's incoming ids) while the node kept mapping them. Once they re-entered the free list, the next allocation overwrote KV the node was still serving, so a later reader of that node could see another request's KV.

```
position     0                16            24      (page size 4, SWA window 8)
             |-- protected ---|---- own ----|
node N       [ p0 p1 p2 p3 ]  [ p4 p5 ]              FULL resident, SWA evicted
request row  [ p0 p1 p2 p3 ]  [ q4 q5 ]              p0..p3 borrowed by reference, q4 q5 fresh

before: recovery starts at the SWA cursor (0)
        locked node   -> frees "incoming" p0..p3     node still maps p0..p3   => double free
        unlocked node -> adopts p0..p3, frees "old" p0..p3                    => double free
after:  recovery starts at max(cursor, 16) = 16
        only [p4 p5] vs [q4 q5] is reconciled; p0..p3 untouched
```

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/unified_cache/components/swa.py`: the recovery window now starts at `max(evicted_seqlen, prev_prefix_len)` for both window kinds instead of only for independent windows. A node straddling the protected prefix is clipped there, so the head keeps its canonical ids and only the tail is recovered. Positions below the protected prefix are never the request's contribution.

Behaviour is unchanged when the cursor is already at or above the protected prefix (chunked and decode inserts) and for independent windows, which were clamped before. No allocator, scheduler, or controller change. The Rust tree core under `rust/sglang-radix-tree` keeps its own recovery path and is not changed here.

## Accuracy Tests

Local CPU run of the unified-cache SWA unit tests on this branch:

```
python -m pytest test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_swa_unittest.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_swa_locked_full_recover_unified.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_session_unified_radix_cache.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_unified_hicache_regressions.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/unified_radix_cache/test_unified_radix_cache_core.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_component_split_contract.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_buffer_swa_tail_only.py
518 passed, 59 skipped
```

Model outputs are unaffected on the paths that were already correct; the change only stops the recovery from freeing pages below the protected prefix. GPU suites were not run locally; CI covers them.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: one `max()` on an insert path that already computed both operands.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (No new test in this PR; the existing unified-cache SWA tests above exercise the changed path.)
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not needed.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not needed; see above.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -481,9 +481,12 @@ def update_component_on_insert_overlap(
         if params.prev_prefix_len >= total_prefix_len + prefix_len:
             return prefix_len
 
-        window_start = params.get_evicted_seqlen(self.component_type)
-        if self._independent:
-            window_start = max(window_start, params.prev_prefix_len)
+        # Never recover below the request's protected prefix: the incoming row
+        # there holds the node's own canonical ids, so a lower window cursor
+        # would free pages the node keeps (mirrors the Rust core).
+        window_start = max(
+            params.get_evicted_seqlen(self.component_type), params.prev_prefix_len
+        )
         consumed_from = prefix_len
         for fragment, start, end in self._segments(
             node=node, start=total_prefix_len, end=total_prefix_len + prefix_len
